status_summary: FERC did not change course on its long-term regional transmission planning and cost allocation rule (Order No. 1920, issued in 2024); on 2025-04-11 it issued Order No. 1920-B, published 2025-04-28, which addressed rehearing and sustained the rule's key requirements. FERC has since extended compliance dates for several regions; its schedule page updated 2026-08-19 lists first compliance filings from December 2025 through June 2027. Petitions for review of the orders are consolidated in the Fourth Circuit under lead No. 24-1650, including a petition the Tenth Circuit transferred there on 2025-02-27. In a 2026-09-25 filing, PJM's transmission owners and state entities proposed filing dates of 2026-11-19 and 2026-12-22 for cost allocation, and noted that the Fourth Circuit petitions were argued on 2026-09-15 and remain pending.

timeline.event: The Fourth Circuit consolidates No. 24-1991 (Commonwealth of Kentucky v. FERC, a petition for review of FERC's transmission planning orders transferred from the Sixth Circuit) with lead case No. 24-1650 (Appalachian Voices v. FERC) and places it in abeyance.
